s1.title: 1. Overview
s1.p: PPPlayer ("we", "our", "the app") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect, why, and how it is used when you use PPPlayer on macOS, Linux, Windows, iOS, or Android.

s2.title: 2. No Account Required
s2.p: PPPlayer does not require you to create an account. We do not collect your name, email address, or any personally identifiable information to use the app.

s3.title: 3. Data We Collect
s3.p1: We may collect the following anonymous, non-identifiable data:
s3.li1: Crash reports and error logs (to improve app stability)
s3.li2: Anonymous usage analytics (feature usage, session duration)
s3.li3: Device type and operating system version
s3.p2: We do not collect: names, emails, payment info, or precise location data.

s4.title: 4. Third-Party Services
s4.p: PPPlayer may use third-party services for music metadata and analytics. These services have their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review them.

s5.title: 5. Data Retention
s5.p: Anonymous analytics data is retained for a maximum of 12 months. Crash logs are deleted after 90 days.

s6.title: 6. Your Rights
s6.p: Since we do not collect personal data, there is no personal information to access, export, or delete. If you have questions, contact us at the address below.

s7.title: 7. Children
s7.p: PPPlayer is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect data from children.

s8.title: 8. Changes
s8.p: We may update this policy from time to time. We will note the date of the last update at the top of this page.

s9.title: 9. Contact
s9.p: Questions about this policy? Contact us at

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p: By downloading or using PPPlayer, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

s2.title: 2. Use of the App
s2.p: PPPlayer is free, open-source software. Use, copying, modification, and distribution of the software are governed by the MIT license in the project repository. When using the app, you agree not to:
s2.li1: Remove copyright or permission notices required by the applicable software licenses
s2.li2: Use the app to distribute malware or harmful content
s2.li3: Violate any applicable laws or regulations while using the app

s3.title: 3. No Account Required
s3.p: PPPlayer does not require account creation. You can use all features immediately after download.

s4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
s4.p: PPPlayer source code is available under the MIT license. Third-party dependencies retain their own licenses. Music, artwork, and metadata remain subject to their respective rights and licenses; the software license does not grant rights to that content.

s5.title: 5. Disclaimer of Warranties
s5.p: PPPlayer is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee uninterrupted service or that the app will be error-free.

s6.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
s6.p: To the maximum extent permitted by law, PPPlayer shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from your use or inability to use the app.

s7.title: 7. Changes to Terms
s7.p: We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

s8.title: 8. Contact
s8.p: Questions about these terms? Reach us at

v1_2_0.desc: Expanded localization support with 10 new languages.
v1_2_0.lang10Desc: Added full support for Indonesian, Burmese, Polish, Danish, Kazakh, Czech, Hungarian, Georgian, Swedish, and Uzbek.

v1_1_2.desc: Added Arabic and Chinese localizations and fixed macOS resizing bugs.
v1_1_2.localizationDesc: Added Arabic and Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) localizations.
v1_1_2.layoutDesc: Fixed an issue on macOS where the YouTube video player would shift off-center when resizing the application window.

v1_1_1.desc: Fixed playback bugs and polished the seekbar on app startup.
v1_1_1.snapDesc: Fixed an issue where the seek bar would instantly snap back to the start position when sliding it immediately after launching the app.
v1_1_1.durationDesc: Fixed the seek bar showing a duration of 0:00 when the app is first launched.

v1_1_0.desc: Comprehensive internationalization and localization across the entire app and website.
v1_1_0.langDesc: Added full support for Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Russian, and Arabic.
v1_1_0.pickerDesc: Added an in-app language picker in the Preferences menu that applies translations instantly without restarting the app.
v1_1_0.osDesc: Native OS-level language integrations on Android 13+ and iOS to sync the app's language automatically.

v1_0_6.crashDesc: Fixed a critical bug causing the app to crash on a blank screen on fresh installations due to a missing environment configuration file.

v1_0_5.appNapDesc: Prevented macOS App Nap from aggressively suspending the player when minimized, allowing the queue to continue uninterrupted.

v1_0_4.ciDesc: GitHub Actions workflow for consistent builds and macOS code signing.
v1_0_4.signedDesc: Official signed and notarized macOS releases now available directly on the website.
v1_0_4.licenseDesc: Added MIT License to the repository.
v1_0_4.submoduleFix: Fixed submodule checkout configuration in CI workflows

v1_0_3.hybridEngineDesc: Robust background processing and lock-screen playback capabilities.
v1_0_3.dedupDesc: Added generation IDs to prevent overlapping and stale media commands across WebView bridge.
v1_0_3.queueAdvance: Song queue not automatically advancing to the next track
v1_0_3.resumeBug: Paused track unexpectedly resuming when handing off from foreground to PiP or background
v1_0_3.precision: Accurate millisecond precision reporting for current track position and playback duration
v1_0_3.linter: Eliminated several IDE linter errors and cleaned up redundant files

v1_0_2.autoplayContextDesc: Autoplay now prioritizes tracks from the current artist before adding related artists to the queue.
v1_0_2.tieredRecsDesc: Recommendations now strictly use the target artist's catalog instead of fuzzy searching by name.

v1_0_1.autoplayDesc: Music keeps going with recommendations based on what you're listening to.
v1_0_1.discoverDesc: Find music based on your listening history, favorite artists and playlists.
v1_0_1.tooltipsDesc: Added dynamic tooltips that perfectly follow your mouse cursor when hovering the player progress bar.
v1_0_1.seekbarPause: Playback pausing/stopping unexpectedly when dragging the seekbar
v1_0_1.bottomBar: Bottom player bar rendering fully transparent and unreadable on macOS when playing music
